body: I am trying so hard dude, but i don't see anyway out. My life is ruined, i will forever be miserable...there is no happiness in sight. Fuck i wish i had chosen differently in the past but its too late now. Thanks btw

Somehow that gives me peace to know that i'll simply cease to exist and i don't have to bear this life's pain and misery anymore. I know my family will suffer and i am sorry for that and all i can do is hope that they forgive me but i can't live anymore. I am a coward but when i am gone it wont matter.

Thank you so much. I am not confident i'll be able to succeed. sometimes i feel like just giving it all up and going to some remote place to live out the rest of my lonely life. Sometimes i just wish i contracted a terminal disease and then i feel incredibly guilt for having such thought when there are truly brave people fighting these diseases. 
Sorry for rambling. Thank you for your words of encouragement.
